text:
mira: Heads-up — PR #3125 is blocked on a naming tweak + formatter disagreement. CI shows gofumpt diffs on the proto-generated structs. Can we decide if we allow a formatter exception for that file or rename the field instead?
ryan: I skimmed it — the change is just renaming `user_id` -> `userID` to match our conventions, but the proto-gen tags keep the `json:\"user_id\"` so gofumpt wants to reflow lines.
alex: could we keep the proto name and change only Go-side field? That feels risky for serialization. Any reason we can't follow proto naming and keep snake_case in json tags?
sam: the problem is the linewrap rule in gofumpt, it collapses the struct tags onto multiple lines which CI flags. We either exempt the generated file from gofumpt or tweak the generator flags.
ci-bot: build #3125 — fmt check failed: 1 file would be modified by gofumpt. Run `gofumpt -w` locally to see diff.
mira: quick proposal: exclude `pkg/gen/*_pb.go` from gofumpt in fmt CI, add a short comment header on generated files explaining why. That avoids touching generated code. Thoughts?
ryan: I'm okay with that as long as we don't leave hand-modified generated files in tree. Maybe add a check that generated files match `make generate` so we still enforce correctness.
alex: SGTM. Two concerns: (1) other languages' formatters might still be applied later, (2) we should record the exemption in the repo README so future contributors know.
sam: implementation note — in CI we can change the `gofumpt` target to `git diff --name-only origin/main... | grep -E 'pkg/gen/.*_pb.go' && echo \"skip\"` style, but simpler is to add `!(pkg/gen/*_pb.go)` to the find invocation. I can open a tiny CI PR.
mergebot: merge check: PR #3125 requires 2 approvals and passing CI. Current status: 0/2 approvals, fmt failed.
mira: @sam please do the CI tweak PR, small change. I'll update #3125 to revert the `userID` rename back to `UserId` to match proto, and add a generated-file header. Then we can re-run.
sam: on it, I'll include a short blurb in the CONTRIBUTING.md about generated files and format exemptions. Plan: open CI patch in next hour.
ryan: once CI patch lands, @mira rebase and push; I'll take first approval and alex can be second. If CI still complains after exemption, ping me and we'll iterate.
alex: ack, can review after rebase. :thumbsup:
mira: thanks — will follow up in PR comments.
